quality.rationale: MVP functionality is implemented and verified with automated tests, production build, and headless Chromium runtime gate. Direct canvas editing, multi-selection alignment, canvas alignment, layer D&D, layer locking and deletion, named color palette entries with Fill/Stroke targets, task-tab information architecture, Image Lab modal Rect/Circle drag cutouts and chroma key, font dropdown, sliders, and named templates are included. Cross-browser coverage remains future work.

cost.rationale: Static browser-only GitHub Pages app with no backend or paid service dependency.

delivery.rationale: Implementation, docs, tests, build, Pages workflow, release checklist, runtime evidence, and a passing remote Pages deployment are complete. Broader real-device checks remain future work.

satisfaction.rationale: Primary requested workflow passed: CSV/HTML import, image import, left Assets/Layouts/Templates tabs, right Layers/Adjust/Colors tabs, inspector edits, direct canvas move/resize/rotate, multi-select alignment, canvas alignment, named Fill/Stroke palette registration/apply, lock toggles, layer ordering, Delete-key removal, delete confirmation modal cancel/confirm, Adjust controls without duplicated numeric readouts, font dropdown, multiple template saves, Image Lab modal workspace, Image Lab Rect/Circle drag selection, Image Lab drag/polygon cutouts with chroma key, effects controls, sliders, and PNG/JPEG/WebP export path. Broader template variety and cross-browser checks remain future work.

runtimeGate.requirement: Chrome or headless browser confirms nonblank render, primary elements, and primary operations.
checks: Adjust labels without duplicate numeric readouts
